title: Philippine economy slips to 2.1% in Q3

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The country’s economy slumped deeper to 2.1 percent in the third quarter of 2026 from 2.4 percent in the previous quarter, the Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA) reported on Monday. This marked the fifth consecutive quarter of economic slowdown, as government spending and domestic demand remained weak amid pressures from the corruption scandal and Middle East war.
